name: Smoked Salmon "Everything Bagel" Pasta Salad with Cream Cheese

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water to cool.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g macaroni (elbow) pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ bunches radish
1 small bunch fresh dill

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into a large bowl. Add honey, poppy seeds, sesame seeds, garlic powder, and salt, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp honey
1 tbsp poppy seeds
1 tbsp sesame seeds
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Trim and halve radishes, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop capers. Add to the bowl.
Medium dice cream cheese. Add to the bowl.
Chop or tear smoked salmon into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl, along with the cooled pasta, and stir to combine the pasta salad.
To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
